string.text: Close trade, crafting, and dialogue with a key as well as Escape. Those UIs swallow normal key callbacks, so this bind is polled while one of them is open and pulses the Exit key. Tab by default.
Press while an allowed window is open to send Exit (Escape). Unbound = off.
Close trader buy/sell with the bind.
Close the toolbench stash/use menu, gunsmithing tools, and other workshop UIs with the bind.
End an NPC conversation with the bind.
